publishedMetadata.title: Suspense and SSR hydration
publishedMetadata.description: A practical TanStack Query 5 lesson teaching suspense and ssr hydration using real Next.js 16 server rendering and client hydration scenarios with separate starter and instructor assertions.
objectives: Prefetch safe public data in a Next.js Server Component, dehydrate it, and hydrate the same query key on the client.
In a real Next.js app, compare server and client query keys exactly. Inspect dehydrated state and verify only safe anonymous data appears; test hydration with a mounted QueryClientProvider.
Never dehydrate authentication tokens, internal service responses, another user's tasks or secrets into a public HTML payload. This server-only example is not a Vite browser route.
